mapper.select: select a.alert_id as alertId, a.team_uuid as teamUuid, b.name as teamName, b.email as teamEmail, b.phone as teamPhone from alert_team a join team b on a.team_uuid = b.uuid where a.alert_id = #{value}

select b.uuid as userId, b.user_id AS userAccount, b.user_name AS userName, b.phone AS userPhone, b.email AS userEmail from team_user_title a join user b on a.user_uuid = b.uuid where a.team_uuid = #{value} order by a.title_sort

select b.uuid as userId, b.user_id AS userAccount, b.user_name AS userName, b.phone AS userPhone, b.email AS userEmail from user_team a join user b on a.user_uuid = b.uuid where a.team_uuid = #{value}

select a.alert_id AS alertId, a.user_id AS userId, b.user_id AS userAccount, b.user_name AS userName, b.phone AS userPhone, b.email AS userEmail from alert_user a join user b on a.user_id = b.uuid where a.alert_id = #{value}

select a.id, (SELECT count(x.to_alert_id) FROM alert_rel x WHERE x.from_alert_id = a.id LIMIT 100) AS childAlertCount, (select x.from_alert_id from alert_rel x where x.to_alert_id = a.id limit 1) as fromAlertId, a.level, a.title, a.update_time as updateTime, a.alert_time as alertTime, a.type, a.is_close as isClose, a.similar_count as similarCount, d.id as alertTypeId, d.name as alertTypeName, d.label as alertTypeLabel, a.status, als.label as alertStatusName, als.color as alertStatusColor, a.source, a.unique_key as uniqueKey, b.content, c.level as alertLevel, c.name as alertLevelName, c.label as alertLevelLabel, c.color as alertLevelColor, au.user_id as alertUserId, au.alert_id as alertUserAlertId, at.team_uuid as alertTeamUuid, at.alert_id as alertTeamAlertId, (select name from team x where x.uuid = at.team_uuid) as alertTeamName, am.name as alertMarkName, am.uuid as alertMarkUuid, am.style as alertMarkStyle from alert a left join alert_attr b on a.id = b.alert_id left join alert_level c on a.level = c.level left join alert_type d on a.type = d.id left join alert_user au on a.id = au.alert_id left join alert_team at on a.id = at.alert_id left join alert_status als on a.status = als.name left join alert_alert_mark aam on a.id = aam.alert_id left join alert_mark am on aam.mark_uuid = am.uuid where a.id = #{value}
mapper.sql: select id, name, uuid, alert_type as alertType, parent_id as parentId, handler, event, sort, type_id as typeId, is_async as isAsync, is_active as isActive, config as configStr from alert_event_handler
mapper.select: select count(1) from alert_event_handler_audit where handler = #{handler} and start_time > FROM_UNIXTIME(#{miniSecond} / 1000)

select id, unique_key as uniqueKey, parent_id as parentId, alert_id as alertId, event, handler, handler_name as handlerName, event_handler_id as eventHandlerId, start_time as startTime, end_time as endTime, status from alert_event_handler_audit where alert_id = #{alertId} and event_handler_id = #{eventHandlerId} and status = #{status} order by id desc limit 1
select name, config as configStr, is_active as isActive from alert_event_plugin
select name, config as configStr, is_active as isActive from alert_event_plugin where name = #{value}
mapper.update: insert into alert_event_plugin (name, config, is_active) values (#{name}, #{configStr, typeHandler=CompressHandler}, #{isActive}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_active = #{isActive}, config = #{configStr, typeHandler=CompressHandler}
mapper.insert: insert into alert_event_handler (id, uuid, parent_id, name, alert_type, handler, event, sort, config, is_active, is_async, type_id) values (#{id}, #{uuid}, #{parentId}, #{name}, #{alertType}, #{handler}, #{event}, #{sort}, #{configStr,typeHandler=CompressHandler}, #{isActive}, #{isAsync}, #{typeId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = #{name}, parent_id = #{parentId}, config = #{configStr,typeHandler=CompressHandler}, is_active = #{isActive}, is_async = #{isAsync}, type_id = #{typeId}

insert into alert_event_handler_audit (id, unique_key, parent_id, alert_id, event, handler, handler_name, event_handler_id, start_time, config, status, server_id, is_async) values (#{id}, #{uniqueKey}, #{parentId}, #{alertId}, #{event}, #{handler}, #{handlerName}, #{eventHandlerId}, now(3), #{configStr,typeHandler=CompressHandler}, #{status}, #{serverId}, #{isAsync})
